answer: A sponsored bridge admits a newcomer only when an established sponsor locks 150 credits behind that identity. Idle sponsors slide down the reputation ridge, losing 5 credits per epoch until work restores them. If a newcomer proves fake, its bond is slashed and the sponsor loses 50 more, so sponsor farming a nebula of fakes pays twice per fake. The kth fake costs 150 credits plus 5 per idle epoch, so 1,000 fakes lock 150,000 credits and bleed 5,000 per idle epoch, with no bond reused. An honest agent pays one bond, keeps it safe with real work, and holds full standing.
